tools.name: detect_invoice
tools.description: Identify the format, syntax, profile/customization and country standard of an e-invoice file. Cheap first step before validating.

tools.name: parse_invoice
tools.description: Extract the invoice as normalised JSON: number, dates, seller, buyer, lines, VAT breakdown, totals, payment details. Works for every supported format.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "validate_invoice" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Run the official rule set for the detected format (KoSIT for XRechnung/ZUGFeRD/Factur-X, OpenPeppol for Peppol BIS, FA(3) schema for KSeF). Returns valid/invalid with every failed rule: id, severity, message, XPath." → after: "Run the official rule set for the detected format (KoSIT for XRechnung/ZUGFeRD/Factur-X, OpenPeppol for Peppol BIS, FA(3) schema for KSeF, Porezna uprava HR-CIUS schematron for Croatian eRačun, Facturae XSD + calculation/NIF/DIR3 rules for Spain, LHDN SDK rules for MyInvois). Returns valid/invalid w"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
